extra.message: User input from request.GET['host'] is concatenated directly into a shell command passed to os.system(). This allows arbitrary OS command execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: User input from request.GET['url'] is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen without validation. This allows Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
User input from request.GET['packet_ref'] is concatenated to a base directory and used in read_text(). This allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the system via path traversal.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: User input from request.GET['name'] is concatenated to a base directory and used as a target for write_bytes(). This allows an attacker to write arbitrary files to the filesystem via path traversal.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The lxml.etree.XMLParser is configured with resolve_entities=True and no_network=False, which makes the application vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) attacks when parsing user-supplied request body.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: User input from request.GET['lane'] (or POST) is passed directly to redirect(). This leads to an Open Redirect vulnerability.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: The Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is set directly to the value of the 'Origin' request header without validation. Combined with Allow-Credentials=true, this allows any site to make authenticated requests to this endpoint.

cwe: CWE-942: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output ('Cross-Site Scripting')

extra.message: The application writes user-controlled data (ssn and card) directly into a JSON file on disk.
